title: Synthesis, characterization and bioactivity of chalcone-based polybenzoxazine/copper oxide nanocomposites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37263-37272
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04893A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hamada S. A. Mandour, Ahmed Rehab, Mohamed Elnahrawy, Nehal Salahuddin
Chalcone-based benzoxazine/copper oxide nanocomposites were synthesized. Incorporation of nanoparticles of copper oxide into the polybenzoxazine matrix enhanced the thermal stability and improved the bioactivity of benzoxazines.
